content: Abeseloome Makkalleteth
Hessafe guye Abeseloomey para-gaarenne parata, hessaththoka izappe sinththara woxxanaas 50 asata baas giigsides.

Abeseloomey maalado wonttara dendidi katama penge gelththiza oge gaxan eqqi naagees. Ay asikka ba misha kawos magannidi pirdisana yiza wode ubbaan Abeseloomey izaade baakko xeygi xeygidi, «Ne awa katamappe yadii?» gi oychchees; he oyshettida addezikka, «Ta ne oosanchchay Isra7eele qommota garsafe issaafe yadis» gi zaarees.
Hessafe guye Abeseloomey izas, «Be7a! Ne maganazi likkenne bessizaaza; gido attiin kawo wokkaletappe hayssa xeellana asi nees deenna» gees.
Kaaleththidikka, «Tani hanno biittay bolla pirdiza daanna gida shuumettidaakko aazee dizay? Maganay woykko mootoy diza asi ubbay taakko yiidi suure pirda demmana mala ta ooththanakkoshin» gees.
Hessaththoka ay asikka izakko shiiqidi sarokkiza wode Abeseloomey ba kushen idimmi oykkidi yeerees.
Kawozaakko suure pirda demmanaas yiza Isra7eele asa ubbaakko Abeseloomey hessaththo hani hani shiiqiza gishshas Isra7eele asaa wozina ekkides.
Oyddu layththafe guye Abeseloomey kawoza, «Tani adinettida adina gaththanaas Kebroone baanaas taas piqaade imma.
Tani ne oosanchchay Aaraame deren Geeshuren dashe, ‹GODAY tana Yerusalaame zaarizaa gidikko GODAAS Kebroonen goynnana› ga adinettadis» gides.
Kawozi iza, «Saron ba» gides; hessa gishshas Abeseloomey Kebroone bides.
Hessafe guye Abeseloomey, «Intte zaye giiris siyiza wode, ‹Abeseloomey Kebroonen kawotides› giite gaana oosanchchata kumeththa Isra7eele qommota ubbaa giddon qotara woththides» gides.
Yerusalaameppe 200 asati izara issife bida; istti imaththateth xeygettidi ashketeththan bida attiin istti yo7oza gishshas aykkoka eriza miishshi deenna.

Abeseloomey yarshoza shiishshiza wode Dawite zoriza Gilo dere as Akxofeele ba biitta Giloppe izakko yaana mala kiittides; hessa gishshas seerazi minnides; Abeseloome kaallizayta qooday gujetti gujetti bides.
Dawite Baqata
Kiitettizayssi yiidi, «Isra7eele asaa wozinay Abeseloomera dees» giidi Dawites yootides.

Hessafe guye Dawiti ba shuume ubbatas, «Dendite; ane baqatoos; nu histtontta aggiko nuuppe issaadeyka Abeseloome kusheppe kessi ekki attenna; ha7ira nu hayssafe kezana bessees; nu histtontta aggiko kaaletti yiidi nuna oykkiko izi nuna dhayssana; katamayokka mashshan siifana» gides.
Kawoza shuumetikka, «Nu kawoy koyidayssa ubbaa ooththanaas nuni ne oosanchchati giigetti uttidos» gi zaarida.
Kawozi baso asaa kumeththaara kezi bides; kawoteththa keeththaa naagana mala 10 laggeththota woththides.
Hessa gishshas kawoy kumeththa asaara haakki bidaappe guye heen issison eqqida.
Asay ubbay Kelitetinne Peliteti hessaththoka Geeteppe izara yida 600 asata gujjiin salfidi kawoza sinth aadhdhida.
Kawozi Geete dere as Ittayey, «Ne nunara ays yadii? Simmada kawo Abeseloomera issife utta; neni ne hu7es ne biittafe di7etta yida imaththa.
Neni ha7i zine yadasa; histtiin ta taas awa bizaakko erontta dashe ne nunara toylattana mala ays ooththoo? Ane ha7i neni ne asata ekkada guye simma; lo7eteththinne ammaneteththay nenara gido» gides.
Gido attiin Ittayey, «De7o GODAY be7iin, hessaththoka ta godaa kawo asho; de7o gidiin hayqo gidiin awankka ta godaa kawoy hanizayssa tani ne ayllezi hanana» gi zaarides.
Dawitikka Ittaye, «Histtiko sinth aadhdha ba» gides; hessa gishshas Geete dere as Ittayey ba asatanne banara diza baso asata ekki bides.
Derey ubbay aadhdhi biza wode he dere asay waassishe yeekkides; kawozi Qediroone zulleza pinnides; asay ubbay pinnidi bazzo biitta bides.

Saadooqeykka heen dees; izara issife diza Leweti ubbay Xoossa Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa tookkida; isttika zaaridi Xoossa Caaqo Qaala Taabotaza woththida; Abiyaataarey asay kumeth katamayo yeddi kezanaashe gakkanaas yarsho shiishshides.
Hessafe guye kawozi Saadooqe, «Neni Xoossa Caaqo Qaala Taabotaza ekkada guye katamayo simma. Tani GODAA sinththan ayottidaa gidikko izi tana zaaridi Taabotazanne iza aqosoza ta be7ana mala gaththana.
Gido attiin izi, ‹Ta nenan ufayettabeekke› gizaa gidikko baas lo7o misati beettidayssa ta bolla ooththo; tani ekkanaas giigetta uttadis» gides.

Qasseka kawozi qeese Saadooqe, «Neni nabe gidikkii? Histtiko neni ne naa Akimaasenne Abiyaataare naa Yoonataane nenara ekkada saron guye katamayo simma; neninne Abiyaataarey nam7ati intte nayta ekkidi biite.
Taikka neeppe wore siyana gakkanaas bazzon diza shaafaa pinnizason naagana» gides.
Hessa gishshas Saadooqeynne Abiyaataarey Xoossa Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa guye Yerusalaame zaaridi heen takkida.

Gido attiin Dawiti yeekkishe pude Dabrazayte zuma pudunththaa kezides; ba hu7e gullunttidi mela tohora dees; izara issife diza asay ubbay izayssaththo bantta hu7e gullunttidi yeekkishe pudunththaa kezeettes.
He wode, «Seeraa giddon Abeseloomera dizay Akxofeele» gi Dawites yootida; hessa gishshas Dawiti, «Abeet GODAWU! Akxofeele zoreza hada histtarkkii» gi woossides.
Dawiti derey Xoossa goynnizasoho pude zumaa kaara gakkishin Arkke dere as Hushey ba may7o daakkidi ba hu7e bolla gudulla laallidi izara gayttanaas yides.
Hessafe guye Dawiti iza, «Neni tanara issife biikko taas tooho gidana;
gido attiin neni guye katamayo simmada Abeseloomes, ‹Ta ne aylle gidana; kase tani ne aawaas aylle gidida mala hachchika ta nees haggazana› gaada Akxofeele zore ne laallada tana maaddana.
Qeeseti Saadooqeynne Abiyaataarey heen nenara daana deettennee? Kawo keeththafe ne siyidayssa ubbaa isttas yoota.
Saadooqe naa Akimaasinne Abiyaataare naa Yoonataaney nam7u attuma nayti heen isttara deettes. Ne siyiza ubbaa taas istta bolla kiita yedda» gides.
Hessa gishshas Dawites siiqo lagge Hushey Abeseloomey Yerusalaame gelida mala hee gakkides.
